requestedText: Add the approved Weekly Radar runtime dependencies and keep the manifest compatible with the existing Rust build and CI checks.

evidence: The manifest change adds compile-time Rust dependencies only; it does not load runtime references dynamically.
No external consumer contract is changed; the package remains the existing repository crate and the dependency set is exercised by the runtime tests and build.
The manifest change adds no monitoring, telemetry, scheduler, or operational integration.
The Contract explicitly scopes Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock, authorizes the runtime dependency boundary, and requires cargo check, tests, and formatting verification.
